requiredScope: All earlier obligations remain. Strict tables, keys, defaults, other declared types, constraints and table options remain required outside this domain.

Schema/ColumnType.role: Declared type of a column in an ordinary SQLite rowid table.
Schema/ColumnType.structure: Absent declared type, INTEGER, TEXT, REAL or BLOB.
Schema/ColumnType.boundary: Each alternative has a fixed native spelling and affinity.
Schema/ColumnType.meaning: Preserve the declared type in catalog observations and the associated SQLite conversion on writes.
Schema/ColumnType.sql: Emit the native type keyword or omit the type.

Schema/TableColumn.structure: Decoded column identifier, declared type and boolean NOT NULL constraint.
Schema/TableColumn.boundary: The parent checks name uniqueness under SQLite identifier comparison.
Schema/TableColumn.meaning: The column has the declared affinity and, when requested, an unnamed NOT NULL constraint with the default conflict policy.
Schema/TableColumn.sql: Quote the name, emit the optional type, then the optional NOT NULL clause.

Schema/CreateTable.role: Top-level declaration of an ordinary rowid table at an absolute schema location.
Schema/CreateTable.structure: Decoded schema and table names, nonempty ordered columns and boolean IF NOT EXISTS policy.
Schema/CreateTable.boundary: The schema is nonempty, table name is outside the reserved sqlite_ namespace and column names are unique. At most 2000 columns. Analyze resolves main, temp, or a known explicit attached schema.
Schema/CreateTable.meaning: Create an empty table with the defined ordered columns and SQLite rowid behavior. The guard preserves an existing table or view where SQLite specifies a no-op.
Schema/CreateTable.sql: Emit a schema-qualified CREATE TABLE and the checked column declarations in order.

analysis: Lower an ordinary CREATE TABLE with no table constraints or options, and columns with no constraints or a single unnamed NOT NULL without policy. Accept conventional type names irrespective of the spelling variants SQLite canonicalizes.
observations: Column names, order and native declared type
Ordinary insertion affinity and constraint errors
Absence of changes in the other schema

finite.completeness: For a fresh table with one column, independently recover all forty combinations from the observed structure.

negative: Duplicate column under SQLite name comparison
